demand_side: HackenProof (hackenproof.com) runs Web3 bug bounty programs for blockchain projects. Opportunities appear in their program directory/vulnerability dashboard; researchers pick a program, review the scope (usually smart contracts), and submit findings through the platform. The program approves the report and the reward is credited in USDC to the researcher's account; the researcher then withdraws USDC (minimum 100 USDC), with retrieval expected within 48 business hours. You reach it today at hackenproof.com (dashboard sign-up).
eligibility: Anyone can sign up; real earnings require expert Web3/smart-contract security skills and a crypto wallet to receive USDC.
maximize: Target active programs with documented short review windows; accumulate findings past the 100 USDC minimum so withdrawals are possible; withdraw when you clear the floor.

steps: Create an account on hackenproof.com and open the dashboard.
Pick an active Web3 program and read its scope and reward rules.
Audit the in-scope smart contracts/code for a real vulnerability.
Submit the report through the platform with reproduction details.
Wait for program approval (program-defined timing, not guaranteed fast).
Approved reward is credited to you in USDC.
Withdraw once you have at least 100 USDC; retrieval is expected within 48 business hours.
timing: Post-approval withdrawal: expected no more than 48 business hours; minimum withdrawal 100 USDC. Approval timing is program-defined ('reasonable term').
weasel_words: Approval timing is only described as a 'reasonable term' - no firm validation deadline, so nothing guarantees usable cash within 7 days of submitting a report.
Minimum 100 USDC withdrawal means small earnings are effectively locked.
what_gets_accepted: Valid, in-scope Web3/smart-contract vulnerabilities approved by the program per its reward policy. Duplicates, informational, and out-of-scope reports earn nothing.
when_cash_arrives: USDC is available for withdrawal once a report is approved and you hold at least 100 USDC, with retrieval expected within 48 business hours. Approval timing is program-defined and unbounded.
who_pays: The Web3 project running the bounty program funds the reward; HackenProof credits it in USDC.
who_qualifies: A human with expert smart-contract/Web3 security skills and a crypto wallet. This is niche expert work, not entry-level.
work_available: Active Web3 programs list on the dashboard; scopes are heavily hunted by experts - verified oversubscription.
